title: Set 271

sentences.ko: 요즘 잠을 하나도 못 자. 열 시쯤 되면 완전히 녹초가 되는데, 눕기만 하면 머리가 도무지 꺼지질 않아서 결국 새벽 세 시까지 폰을 붙잡고 있다가 회사에서 하루 종일 좀비처럼 지내.
sentences.text: I haven't been sleeping at all lately. I'm wiped out by like ten, but the second I lie down my brain just won't shut off, so I end up scrolling on my phone till three and then I'm a zombie at work all day.

alts.text: Can't sleep at all lately. I'm dead tired by ten, but soon as I hit the pillow my brain won't quit, so I'm on my phone till three and then I'm a total zombie at work.

I have not been sleeping at all recently. I am exhausted by around ten o'clock, but as soon as I lie down my mind will not rest, so I end up on my phone until three and then I am barely functioning at work all day.

sentences.note: **wiped out** 은 기운이 하나도 없이 녹초가 됐다는 뜻이에요. **the second I lie down** 은 눕자마자라는 말로, the second 가 ~하는 순간을 뜻해요.

sentences.ko: 네가 말해 준 그 식당 드디어 가 봤어. 음식은 진짜 맛있더라, 그건 인정. 근데 자리 나는 데 거의 한 시간을 기다려서, 누가 사 주는 거 아니면 아마 다시는 안 갈 것 같아.
sentences.text: So we finally tried that place you told us about. The food was really good, I'll give you that, but we waited almost an hour for a table, so I probably wouldn't go back unless somebody else is paying.

alts.text: Okay, we finally hit up that place you mentioned. Food was great, gotta admit, but we waited like an hour for a table, so I'm not going back unless someone else is buying.
We finally visited the restaurant you recommended. I must admit the food was excellent, but we waited nearly an hour for a table, so I would probably not return unless someone else were paying.

sentences.note: **I'll give you that** 은 상대 말에서 그 부분은 인정한다는 표현이에요. **unless somebody else is paying** 은 남이 돈을 내지 않는 한이라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 추천한 식당 다녀와서 후기 말하기

sentences.ko: 이번 주말에 캠핑 가기로 했었는데, 내내 비가 온다고 해서 그냥 집에 있기로 했어. 솔직히 좀 다행이다 싶어. 어차피 땅바닥에서 자는 거 별로 내키지 않았거든.
sentences.text: We were supposed to go camping this weekend, but they're saying it's going to rain the whole time, so we're just staying home. Honestly, I'm kind of relieved, because I wasn't looking forward to sleeping on the ground anyway.

alts.text: Camping this weekend's off. They say it's gonna rain the whole time, so we're staying in. Kinda relieved, honestly. Wasn't excited about sleeping on the ground anyway.

We had planned to go camping this weekend, but the forecast calls for rain the entire time, so we will be staying home. To be honest, I am somewhat relieved, as I was not looking forward to sleeping on the ground in any case.

sentences.note: **were supposed to** 는 원래 ~하기로 되어 있었다는 뜻으로, 계획이 틀어졌을 때 써요. **looking forward to** 는 기대하다라는 뜻인데 부정으로 쓰면 내키지 않았다는 말이 돼요.

sentences.ko: 솔직하게 말해 줄까? 재킷은 예쁜데 너한테 딱 어울리는 스타일은 아닌 것 같아. 그거 입으니까 면접 보러 가는 사람 같아. 너 평소에는 훨씬 편하게 입잖아.
sentences.text: Do you want me to be honest? It's a nice jacket, but I don't think it's really you. It makes you look like you're on your way to a job interview, and you usually dress way more relaxed than that.

alts.text: Want the truth? Nice jacket, but it's not really you. You look like you're headed to a job interview, and you normally dress way more chill.

May I be honest with you? It is a lovely jacket, but I do not think it is quite your style. It gives the impression that you are on your way to a job interview, and your usual style is considerably more relaxed.

sentences.note: **it's not really you** 는 옷이나 스타일이 그 사람답지 않다는 뜻이에요. **way more relaxed** 에서 way 는 훨씬이라는 뜻으로 비교를 강조해요.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 부엌 싱크대 고치는 법 찾아보려고 앉았는데, 어쩌다 보니 어떤 아저씨가 옛날 차 고치는 영상을 두 시간이나 보고 있었어. 정작 찾던 영상은 보지도 못해서 싱크대는 아직도 물이 새.
sentences.text: I sat down to look up how to fix the kitchen sink, and somehow I ended up watching some guy rebuild an old car for two hours. And the sink's still leaking, because I never even got to the video I was looking for.

alts.text: Went to look up how to fix the kitchen sink and somehow ended up watching a guy rebuild an old car for two hours. Sink's still leaking, too, since I never got to the video I wanted.

I sat down to research how to repair the kitchen sink, and somehow I spent two hours watching a man restore an old car. The sink is still leaking, because I never reached the video I had been looking for.

sentences.note: **somehow I ended up** 은 어쩌다 보니 결국 ~하게 됐다는 뜻이에요. **never even got to** 는 ~까지 가 보지도 못했다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

reviewed: 3번 casual: 쉼표로 두 문장을 이어 붙여(comma splice) 소리내어 읽을 때 끊는 자리가 애매해서 마침표로 나눔
3번 formal: text의 anyway 뜻이 빠져 있어서 in any case로 되살림
4번 formal: I do not think it suits you는 안 어울린다는 말이라 그 사람답지 않다는 text의 뜻과 달라서 not quite your style로 고침
2번 ko: 너가를 입말로도 자연스러운 네가로 고침
